sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 175 (per-loop search + campsitePaging.do, all 182 campsites and 32 cabins parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. Campsites need 2 nights, but a 1-night stay can be booked within 7 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. Two vehicles per site; extra cars pay a fee.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/fair-haven-beach-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=175 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'Reservations for campsites may be booked 9 months in advance for a 2-night minimum stay'; 'If you make your reservation within 7 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights ... must leave the site and facility for 48 hours'; 'Maximum of 2 vehicles allowed per campsite'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 69 electric sites on ReserveAmerica: all 43 Bluff sites and 2 Lakeview sites at 30 amp; in Drumlin A, 12 at 30 amp and 12 at 50 amp. Drumlin B has none. No full hookups. (The park description says Bluff 44 electric and Drumlin 125 non-electric.)

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 175 ('Electric Hookup available: 30 amp' 57, '50 amp' 12 (all Drumlin Campground - Section A), 'Electric Hookup - no' 113, 'Full Hookup - no' 182) + campground page ('Bluff – 44 electric sites', 'Drumlin – 125 non-electric sites', 'Lakeview Area – 12 non-electric sites, two electric sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 182 campsites in Bluff, Drumlin A, Drumlin B and Lakeview, all back-in; most listed at 25-35 ft (Bluff mostly 30), 20 at 10 ft, one at 40 ft (Drumlin B). Plus 32 cabins and 4 cottages.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/fair-haven-beach-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=175 ('Campsite (182)', 'Cabin (32)', 'Cottage (4)') + ReserveAmerica site list ('30 Back-In' 46, '25 Back-In' 30, '35 Back-In' 31, '20 Back-In' 31, '10 Back-In' 20, '40 Back-In' 1, 'Back-In' 10 among campsites; the only pull-throughs are cabins), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/fair-haven-beach-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=175 ('one centralized restroom with showers', 'camp store'; Services and Amenities 'Dump Station', 'Hot Showers', 'Water Fillup Station', 'Convenience Store'), read 2026-10-21
